cases.steps: 同版本加入两次；创建新版本；显式换版；发布、提交后尝试换版。
cases.inputs: 数字题V1、V2；答案键为实例ID
cases.expected: 实例ID不同；原快照不自动更新；换版保持ID；发布后拒绝；答卷不变。
cases.source:
@case('复用快照', '同版本加入两次；创建新版本；显式换版；发布、提交后尝试换版。', '数字题V1、V2；答案键为实例ID', '实例ID不同；原快照不自动更新；换版保持ID；发布后拒绝；答卷不变。')
def test_snapshots_and_published_freeze(client):
    h,b,q=library(client)
    sid,a=import_into(client,h,q)
    _,bq=import_into(client,h,q,sid)
    assert len({a['id'],bq['id'],q['id'],q['latest_version']['id']}) == 4
    v=version(client,h,q).json()
    base=f'/api/surveys/{sid}'
    assert client.get(base,headers=h).json()['questions'][0] == a
    path=base+f'/questions/{a["id"]}/version'
    body={'question_id':q['id'],'version_id':v['id']}
    changed=client.put(path,headers=h,json=body).json()['questions'][0]
    assert changed['id']==a['id'] and changed['source']['version_id']==v['id']
    assert client.put(base+f'/questions/{a["id"]}',headers=h,json=v['content']).status_code == 409
    assert client.post(base+'/publish',headers=h).status_code == 200
    assert client.post(f'/api/fill/{sid}/submit',headers=h,json={'answers':{a['id']:10,bq['id']:20}}).status_code == 201
    d=client.app.state.db
    before=d.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid}); response=d.responses.find_one()
    assert client.put(path,headers=h,json=body).status_code == 409
    version(client,h,q,title='第三版',key='third')
    assert d.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid})==before and d.responses.find_one()==response

cases.steps: 建草稿；添加文本题；改为数字题并比较ID；添加无选项单选。
cases.inputs: 姓名/text→年龄/number/integer=true；single无options。
cases.expected: 添加201；编辑保持原题ID；无选项单选422。此用例未独立断言编辑请求状态码。
cases.preconditions: 本机MongoDB可用；每实例独立UUID测试库。
cases.source:
def test_add_edit(client):
    h=login(client)
    s=client.post("/api/surveys",headers=h,json={"title":"问卷"}).json()
    url="/api/surveys/"+s["id"]+"/questions"
    q=client.post(url,headers=h,json={"title":"姓名","type":"text"})
    assert q.status_code == 201
    qid=q.json()["questions"][0]["id"]
    changed=client.put(url+"/"+qid,headers=h,json={"title":"年龄","type":"number","integer":True})
    assert changed.json()["questions"][0]["id"] == qid
    assert client.post(url,headers=h,json={"title":"错误","type":"single"}).status_code == 422

def test_valid():
    assert validate_answer(question(required=False),None) is None
    assert validate_answer(question("number",integer=True,min_value=0,max_value=120),120) == 120
    assert validate_answer(question(min_length=2,max_length=2),"中文") == "中文"

cases.steps: 构造带规则题与被跳过题；检查规则；完整walk；再加入路径外答案。
cases.inputs: kind/op/value/answer见实例参数；命中目标END；路径外题skip。
cases.expected: 匹配路径仅[q]；包含skip答案时抛HTTPException。
cases.preconditions: 纯函数/本地文件自动测试；无需MongoDB业务数据。
cases.source:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind,op,value,answer",[
    ("single","eq","a","a"),
    ("multiple","contains_any",["a"],["a","b"]),
    ("multiple","contains_all",["a","b"],["a","b"]),
    ("number","gte",18,20),
])
def test_jump(kind,op,value,answer):
    opts={"options":[{"id":"a","label":"A"},{"id":"b","label":"B"}]} if kind != "number" else {}
    q=question(kind,**opts)
    q["rules"]=[{"op":op,"value":value,"target":"END"}]
    qs=[q,{**question(),"id":"skip"}]
    validate_rules(qs)
    assert walk(qs,{"q":answer})["path"] == ["q"]
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException): walk(qs,{"q":answer,"skip":"非法额外答案"})

    q=question(kind,**opts)
    q["rules"]=[{"op":op,"value":value,"target":"END"}]
    qs=[q,{**question(),"id":"skip"}]
    validate_rules(qs)
    assert walk(qs,{"q":answer})["path"] == ["q"]
    with pytest.raises(HTTPException): walk(qs,{"q":answer,"skip":"非法额外答案"})

def test_rule_persistence(client):
    h=login(client)
    sid=client.post("/api/surveys",headers=h,json={"title":"规则"}).json()["id"]
    url="/api/surveys/"+sid
    qid=client.post(url+"/questions",headers=h,json={"title":"年龄","type":"number"}).json()["questions"][0]["id"]
    rules=[{"op":"lt","value":18,"target":"END"}]
    assert client.put(url+"/questions/"+qid+"/rules",headers=h,json={"rules":rules}).status_code == 200
    assert client.app.state.db.surveys.find_one({"_id":sid})["questions"][0]["rules"] == rules
